project.name: UniGrab
project.description: A clean Python CLI for downloading permitted music, videos, and podcasts from supported sites, media playlists, Internet Archive items, and RSS/Atom podcast feeds.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: User-facing documentation for UniGrab, including installation, usage, supported modes, advanced options, and policy guidance.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Python runtime dependencies for UniGrab: yt-dlp for extraction/downloads, imageio-ffmpeg for FFmpeg access, and mutagen for tags.

nodes.name: unigrab.py
nodes.summary: Single-file Python CLI that resolves media metadata and downloads music, videos, and podcast content through yt-dlp, RSS feeds, public metadata APIs, and platform-specific resolvers.
